messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's one-piece garment with the item shown in the reference images, matching its design, color, and fit from the front and back views. Preserve all other clothing items, footwear, and all non-clothing aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's one-piece garment with the item shown in the reference images. Preserve the other clothing items, footwear, and all non-clothing aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in the open plaza, then raises both arms to the back of the head and holds that pose for several seconds before lowering the arms and standing still again.","camera":"Static medium-long shot from behind and slightly to the side, keeping the figure centered in frame.","clothing":"Light blue long-sleeved button-up shirt with black suspenders, black-and-white checkered trousers, and black shoes.","hair_color":"Pink.","hairstyle":"Short, tousled hair covering the top of the head.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned 3D-rendered male figure, seen mostly from behind, with no clearly visible facial features.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, a large glass-domed building with glowing teal neon rings on the left, and a tall building with rows of blue-lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":["The figure's face is never clearly visible, so facial features and exact age are unclear.","The figure's gender is inferred from body shape and clothing but not definitively shown."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The dark one-piece outfit was replaced by a light checkered long-sleeved shirt with black suspenders and checkered trousers, matching the reference garment's overall design and back view. The figure's pose, hair, shoes, scene, camera, and animation timing remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's one-piece garment with the reference outfit, matching its design, color, and fit from front and back views, while preserving other clothing, footwear, and all non-clothing aspects.
uncertain: The front view of the shirt and trousers is not clearly visible, so exact front-side fit and details cannot be fully verified.
unexpected_changes: The reference bow tie is not clearly visible in the output.
